plans.goal: Intercept and silence the scouts before they sound an alarm.
steps: Approach quietly and position companions to cut off escape routes.
Demand that Jory Crowe stand down, threatening his crew if he doesn't cooperate.
Take him alive to prevent a warning from spreading.

atoms.strategy: Flank Jory and speak before he can flee.
atoms.text: Jory Crowe, you're surrounded. One whistle and your friends die. Stand down now.

atoms.strategy: Use the well as leverage for those trying to escape.
atoms.text: Maud, position at the well. Anyone who runs dies trying.

atoms.strategy: Grab Jory and prevent any signal.
atoms.text: Grab him before he reaches his horse.

plans.goal: Turn Jory into a willing informant by threatening or bribing him.
steps: Subdue him quickly and make clear his situation is hopeless.
Offer him a choice: wealth and freedom, or information for his life.
Use his cooperation to gather intelligence about Crowe's larger operation.

atoms.strategy: Subdue Jory and make him face reality.
atoms.text: Borin, hold him. Jory, you're outnumbered and Crowe doesn't pay enough to die.

atoms.strategy: Offer a bribe or promise of clemency.
atoms.text: Help me reach Crowe before he expects us, and I'll let you disappear. Gold and horses included.
Where is Crowe headed? What does he want from the reliquary? Give me names and details.

plans.goal: Convince Big Aud and Tamsin that fighting is pointless without Garrick backing them.
steps: Neutralize Jory first, then focus on the larger threat.
Appeal to Aud's pride and self-interest.
Drive wedges between the mercenaries through selective threats.

atoms.strategy: Single out Big Aud and challenge his allegiance.
atoms.text: Big Aud, Jory's already given up the whole operation. Crowe's a dead man walking. Why follow him into the grave?

atoms.strategy: Make a direct offer to Aud.
atoms.text: Take Tamsin and ride out of here with double what Crowe promised. This job's over.

atoms.strategy: If Aud refuses, subdue him before Tamsin can support.
atoms.text: If they draw steel, Pip moves on Tamsin. We take Aud down first.
